newsitem.title: USA: S. Calif water agency distributes funds to members.
newsitem.headline: S. Calif water agency distributes funds to members.

text.p: The Metropolitan Water District's board of directors on Tuesday approved the distribution of $70 million of unanticipated revenues and savings among its member agencies in California.

"In the past, when financial conditions have been unfavourable, Metropolitan has turned to its member agencies for additional revenues," said John Foley, the district's board chairman. "Conversely, it seems reasonable that the member agencies should share in the benefits of favourable financial conditions."
The district said the funds became available after it cut costs, revised its capital programme, and received a one-time credit from the state water project.

Through its 27 member public agencies, the district provides almost 60 percent of the water used by nearly 16 million people living in portions of Los Angeles, Orange, Riverside, San Bernardino, San Diego and Ventura counties.
